label: preparing
what: A privately commissioned hospitality order of 200 loaves for the innkeeper's inn arrangement, being delivered and organized for storage in the great hall. The innkeeper says he commissioned it and will settle the baker's account; baker and freight are collaborating on delivery. Evidence does not show any town-authorized event or that the neighbour is a knowing participant. A separate 30-emerald repayment and the claim of spoiled bread are unresolved, and the secretary has no evidence those loaves are spoiled.
